message.content: Starting with broad random sweeps, then targeting rare corners.
Random sweep hit a clearance violation — shrinking it now.
Shrunk to an emergency-triggered case. Replaying to confirm reproducibility.
Ledger: open = emergency preemption skipping clearance; ruled out = nothing yet. Inspecting states around the violation.
Violation shows NS green at step 45. Checking prior steps to trace the switch.
Emergency appears to force an instant green from yellow, skipping clearance. Gathering full violations and a counterfactual.
Cause looks clear — running the one-change counterfactual to prove it.
